name: Jointown Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd
summary: Jointown Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the digital pharmaceutical distribution and supply chain business in China. It operates through Distribution, Industrial, Retail, Medical and Health, and Other divisions. The company offers distribution, warehousing, medical and pharmaceutical logistics, and other services to pharmaceutical manufacturers; medicines and health products; medical, health, and technology value-added services; and digital logistics technology and supply chain solutions.
